dialogues.speaker: Arayesh
dialogues.text: Do you need an in-room haircut service?

dialogues.speaker: Arayesh
dialogues.text: I'm a hair stylist, at your service!

dialogues.speaker: Arayesh
dialogues.text: Leave your hair to me. I will create the most fashionable and suitable hairstyle for you.

dialogues.speaker: Arayesh
dialogues.text: Between cutting, perming, and coloring, I'm the best at coloring, especially color mixes.

dialogues.speaker: Arayesh
dialogues.text: If I were to design a style for you, for example... A little longer here, and a little shorter in the back. That'd frame your face better.

dialogues.speaker: Arayesh
dialogues.text: Then a gradient color... It would be wonderful!

dialogues.speaker: Arayesh
dialogues.text: A change in hairstyle is a change in mood. Come to me if you need a change!
